name: The rainwater tank on the school roof
subject: geography
brief: The Vidyalaya roof gutter feeds a rainwater tank that went from 400 to 1,500 litres in the first week of the monsoon, at about 220 litres a day from the gutter. The same prefect dipped the tank each morning with the same stick. The geography teacher is on examination duty today. How much does the garden tap draw each day? You run the dipstick.

quantities.name: Litres the garden tap draws a day
Litres the gutter adds a day

note: The measurements are consistent, so the discrepancy is none and a hedge wastes the period. Rainfall catchment is the geography side of the water budget; help is scarce because the teacher is away.
